item.description: With four weeks to go until the crucial midterm elections, President Donald Trump is making an all-out push to rally Republicans, trying to appeal to voters on the economy. The president also made rare reversals on mail-in voting and who will pay for the controversial political ads about himself. NBC’s Gabe Gutierrez reports for TODAY.

item.description: After a certain point in some states, there’s no way to hold a perpetrator accountable for sexual assaults.

media:content.media:text: Dana Beatty in the 1990s.
An intruder pressed a knife to Beatty's neck, wrapped her face in tape, lashed her to a bed and assaulted her for hours.
The knife that authorities believe was used in the 1989 attack.
Dana Beatty said eliminating statutes of limitations would be a "true relief.”

item.title: Police knew who her rapist was. The law kept them from prosecuting him for the attack.

item.description: Jade Crossfrench is a single mother supporting three children with a day job selling insurance. But that isn't enough to provide for her family.
